title: 第1927章 专属材料第1926章 邱长老的试探
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 什么？
胡鸣身体猛地一颤，眼皮跳动，有些惶恐。
“你把邱长老给杀了？”
秦易点头，“邱长老与玄冥血族勾结，背叛巴林家族，死有余辜。”
闻言，胡鸣想了想，而后点头道：“杀就杀吧，他们没有证据，暂时应该不会动你。”
胡鸣很久才缓过神来，直到最后一缕火焰消失，邱长老的尸体彻底焚烧的一干二净，院落中的所有痕迹，全部清洗干净之后，他才说道：“秦先生，不管接下来，谁来找你询问，你都假装不知道，一定要咬死没见过邱长老。”
只要他们没有证据，就无法直接针对秦易。
“我知道。”秦易道，目前根据他的了解，整个巴林家族中，除了拥有火神权杖的大长老之外，没有人能对他造成威胁。
“对了，秦先生你找我来，有什么事情吗？”胡鸣问道。
秦易拿出了一份列表，说道：“帮我收集一下这份列表上的材料，这是购买材料所需要的造化天珠。”
说话的同时，秦易拿出一个空间戒指，递给胡鸣。
胡鸣连忙摆手，说道：“每一个顾问，都能领取一份专属修行材料，不用白不用，我这就去帮你领取，不够的我来帮你想办法。”
见胡鸣态度很坚定，秦易也没有说什么，他只是点了点头。
可当胡鸣走到院落门口的时候，秦易突然问道：“你的最大竞争对手都有些谁啊？”
还没等胡鸣说话，秦易咧嘴一笑，说道：“要不，我直接出手帮你把他们全部踢出局，让你迅速的成为最后的胜利者，如何？”
额！
胡鸣权当秦易在开玩笑。
毕竟，秦易天赋再强，也不可能短时间内，力压巴林家族的顶尖强者。
等胡鸣走了之后，凌敏后脚便找来了。
“秦先生。”
凌敏找到秦易，直接开门见山的说道：“胡鸣此次回来，情况不容乐观。”
“怎么了？”秦易问道。
凌敏道：“我跟父亲彻夜长谈，他跟我说了一下巴林家族现在的情况。”
巴林家族现在背腹受敌。
外部敌人自然是雷恩家族，虽然恩怨是大长老挑起来的，可他毕竟代表的是整个巴林家族。
而内部危机，自然就是大长老。
巴林族长也察觉到了大长老图谋不轨，而且他已经在暗中插手此次的族长竞争。
甚至，他从不同渠道，已经得知九大最佳候选人，已经全部投靠到了大长老这边。
对此，巴林族长也是有心无力。
秦易点头，这些事情，他已经了解的差不多了。
巴林家族内部，比想象中混乱很多。
“怎么？他们想杀胡鸣？”秦易问道。
凌敏点头，“大长老的眼睛里容不下一粒沙子，胡鸣是庶出，他当初就是被大长老派系的人逼走的，这一次他光明正大回来，而且还将我带回来，虽说表面上大功一件，实际上大长老派系的脸上无光，他们已经在想办法，想要斩杀胡鸣，敲山震虎。”
而且……
“大长老似乎已经等不及了，他想要让竞争提前开始。”凌敏神色很焦急。
大长老拥有火神权杖，没有人敢忤逆他。
权大一级压死人。
蓬莱阁的内阁长老，在巴林家族几乎可以横着走了。
content_en:
What?
Hu Ming's body trembled suddenly, his eyelids twitched, and he was a little frightened.
"Did you kill Elder Qiu?"
Qin Yi nodded, "Elder Qiu colluded with the Xuanming Blood Clan, betrayed the Balin family, and deserved his death."
Hearing this, Hu Ming thought for a moment, then nodded and said, "Just kill him. They have no evidence, so they shouldn't touch you for the time being."
Qin Yi: "..."
It took Hu Ming a long time to calm down. It was not until the last ray of flame disappeared, Elder Qiu's body was completely burned, and all traces in the courtyard were cleaned, that he said: "Mr. Qin, no matter who comes to ask you next, you pretend not to know, and you must kill Elder Qiu who has never met him."
As long as they have no evidence, they cannot directly target Qin Yi.
"I know." Qin Yidao, according to his current understanding, no one in the entire Bahrain family can pose a threat to him except the elder who holds the Vulcan Scepter.
"By the way, Mr. Qin, you came to see me. What's the matter?" Hu Ming asked.
Qin Yi took out a list and said, "Help me collect the materials on this list. These are the Creation Dzi Beads needed to purchase the materials."
While speaking, Qin Yi took out a space ring and handed it to Hu Ming.
Hu Ming quickly waved his hand and said: "Every consultant can receive an exclusive set of training materials. If you don't use them in vain, I will go and get them for you. If there are not enough, I will help you find a way."
Seeing that Hu Ming's attitude was very firm, Qin Yi didn't say anything, he just nodded.
But when Hu Ming walked to the door of the courtyard, Qin Yi suddenly asked: "Who are your biggest competitors?"
Before Hu Ming could speak, Qin Yi grinned and said, "How about I help you kick them all out and quickly become the final winner?"
Uh!
Hu Mingquan thought Qin Yi was joking.
After all, no matter how talented Qin Yi is, it is impossible for him to defeat the top experts of the Bahrain family in a short period of time.
After Hu Ming left, Ling Min came looking for him.
"Mr. Qin."
Ling Min found Qin Yi and said straight to the point: "The situation is not optimistic when Hu Ming comes back this time."
"What's wrong?" Qin Yi asked.
Ling Min said: "I talked with my father all night long, and he told me about the current situation of the Bahrain family."
The Bahrain family is now under attack from both sides.
The external enemy is naturally the Renn family. Although the feud was started by the great elder, he represents the entire Bahrain family after all.
As for the internal crisis, it was naturally the Great Elder.
Patriarch Bahrain has also noticed that the great elder has evil intentions, and he has secretly intervened in the competition for the patriarch.
He even learned from different channels that all nine of the best candidates had defected to the Great Elder.
In this regard, the Bahrain patriarch is also helpless.
Qin Yi nodded. He already understood most of these things.
The situation within the Bahrain family is much more chaotic than expected.
"What? Do they want to kill Hu Ming?" Qin Yi asked.
Ling Min nodded, "The Great Elder's eyes cannot tolerate a grain of sand. Hu Ming is a concubine. He was forced to leave by the people of the Great Elder's faction. This time he came back openly and brought me back. Although it seems to be a great achievement, in fact the Great Elder's faction has no shame. They are already thinking of ways to kill Hu Ming and knock down the mountain to shake the tiger."
And...
"The Great Elder seems to be unable to wait any longer. He wants to start the competition early." Ling Min looked anxious.
The Great Elder possesses the Vulcan Scepter, and no one dares to disobey him.
A level of power that crushes people to death.
The cabinet elders of Penglai Pavilion can almost walk sideways in the Bahrain family.
